label: History of begun coming-to-be
definition: BegunComingToBeAt h Concrete v holds when every contingent concrete individual of history v comes to be (AllContingentsComeToBeAt) and some contingent concrete individual is present at a moment t whose past has a beginning (BegunAt t). PossiblyBegunComingToBe h Concrete w says some history accessible from w satisfies this. A history with a first moment occupied only by a necessary thing, or by nothing, and contingent things appearing later satisfies it, in discrete or continuous time; an initial state whose contingent things never came to be does not; a beginningless past does not.
note: Analyst framework definition; attribution deferred. The weak version of founded coming-to-be (195b8983, History of founded coming-to-be): same clauses with BegunAt in place of Acc. It is a possibility premise about one accessible history, not a claim about the actual world. Whether such a history is metaphysically possible remains OPEN; it is denied by the initial-state view and by views on which every possible populated past is beginningless.
